harnessSource:
"""Rule-6 mutants for syzygy-bpyt.8.9: one per predicate of the declared-but-unlisted refusal in credential-probe.ts, its place before
the list read, its reason and its record, and the two defaults that keep today's configuration on the old code path.

Each mutant replaces one exact fragment (it must occur exactly once), runs the subject suite in its own process group, restores the
bytes and verifies their digest. Killed: at least one test failed, or the suite did not finish within the timeout.
The execution-rule.ts change is a comment and index.ts adds a type-only export; neither carries a predicate to mutate.
Usage: python3 mutants.py <worktree> <out.json>
"""
import hashlib, json, os, re, signal, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT, OUT = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2])
TIMEOUT = 300
P = 'packages/polaris-dossier/src/credential-probe.ts'
TESTS = ['packages/polaris-dossier/src/credential-probe.test.ts']
COMMAND = ['npx', 'vitest', 'run', '--project', '@syzygy/polaris-dossier', *TESTS]
WHY = "a configured typed adapter declares a credential the repository's adapter-credential list does not hold: ${unlisted.join(', ')}"
DECLARATION_CHECK = (
    "      const unlisted = adapters.flatMap(({ adapter, credentials }) => credentials.filter((file) => !configured.includes(file)).map((file) => `${adapter}: ${file}`));\n"
    "      if (unlisted.length > 0) {\n"
    "        last = { source: described, outcomes: [] };\n"
    "        return { passed: false, why: `" + WHY + "` };\n"
    "      }\n")
LIST_READ = (
    "      const list = source.list();\n"
    "      if (!list.ok) { last = { source: source.describe, outcomes: [] }; return { passed: false, why: `${list.why} (source: ${source.describe})` }; }\n")
DECLARATIONS = 'export const CONFIGURED_ADAPTER_DECLARATIONS: readonly AdapterCredentialDeclaration[] = Object.freeze([]);'
DEFAULT = '  adapters: readonly AdapterCredentialDeclaration[] = CONFIGURED_ADAPTER_DECLARATIONS,\n'
PLANTED = "[{ adapter: 'mutant', credentials: ['/mutant.token'] }]"

MUTANTS = [
    ('D1-refusal-removed', P, '      if (unlisted.length > 0) {\n', '      if (false) {\n'),
    ('D2-refusal-needs-two', P, '      if (unlisted.length > 0) {\n', '      if (unlisted.length > 1) {\n'),
    ('D3-membership-inverted', P, '!configured.includes(file)', 'configured.includes(file)'),
    ('D4-membership-normalized', P, '!configured.includes(file)', '!configured.includes(path.normalize(file))'),
    ('D5-first-adapter-only', P, 'const unlisted = adapters.flatMap(', 'const unlisted = adapters.slice(0, 1).flatMap('),
    ('D6-first-credential-only', P, '=> credentials.filter((file)', '=> credentials.slice(0, 1).filter((file)'),
    ('D7-reason-names-first-only', P, "does not hold: ${unlisted.join(', ')}` };", "does not hold: ${unlisted[0]}` };"),
    ('D8-refusal-passes', P, '        return { passed: false, why: `a configured typed adapter', '        return { passed: true, checked: 0, source: `a configured typed adapter'),
    ('D9-refusal-leaves-last-unset', P, '      if (unlisted.length > 0) {\n        last = { source: described, outcomes: [] };\n', '      if (unlisted.length > 0) {\n'),
    ('D10-check-after-list-read', P, DECLARATION_CHECK + LIST_READ, LIST_READ + DECLARATION_CHECK),
    ('D11-default-declares-a-credential', P, DEFAULT, DEFAULT.replace('CONFIGURED_ADAPTER_DECLARATIONS,', PLANTED + ',')),
    ('D12-repository-declares-a-credential', P, DECLARATIONS, DECLARATIONS.replace('Object.freeze([])', f'Object.freeze({PLANTED})')),
    ('D13-declarations-not-frozen', P, DECLARATIONS, DECLARATIONS.replace('Object.freeze([])', '[]')),
]


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(ROOT), *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout


def run_suite():
    proc = subprocess.Popen(COMMAND, cwd=ROOT, env={**os.environ, 'CI': '1'}, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
    try:
        log, _ = proc.communicate(timeout=TIMEOUT)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        proc.communicate()
        return None, None, []
    text = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m', '', log.decode('utf8', 'replace'))
    tests = next((line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip().startswith('Tests ')), None)
    failed = sorted({line.strip()[2:].strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip().startswith('× ')})
    return proc.returncode, tests, failed


def main():
    subjects = sorted({m[1] for m in MUTANTS})
    originals = {f: (ROOT / f).read_bytes() for f in subjects}
    clean_before = git('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no') == ''
    base_exit, base_tests, base_failed = run_suite()
    results = []
    try:
        for mutant_id, path, old, new in MUTANTS:
            text = originals[path].decode('utf8')
            assert text.count(old) == 1, (mutant_id, old)
            (ROOT / path).write_bytes(text.replace(old, new).encode('utf8'))
            try:
                code, tests, failed = run_suite()
            finally:
                (ROOT / path).write_bytes(originals[path])
            blocked = code is None
            results.append({'id': mutant_id, 'file': path, 'old': old, 'new': new, 'exitCode': code, 'testsLine': tests, 'failedTests': failed,
                            'blocked': blocked, 'outcome': 'killed' if blocked or (code != 0 and failed) else 'survived',
                            'restored': sha((ROOT / path).read_bytes()) == sha(originals[path])})
            print(mutant_id, results[-1]['outcome'], tests or ('blocked' if blocked else ''), flush=True)
    finally:
        for path in subjects:
            (ROOT / path).write_bytes(originals[path])
    record = {
        'title': 'syzygy-bpyt.8.9 rule-6 mutants: the adapter-credential probe refuses a declared-but-unlisted credential',
        'subject': subjects, 'subjectSha256': {f: sha(originals[f]) for f in subjects}, 'bead': 'syzygy-bpyt.8.9',
        'commit': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').strip(), 'command': ' '.join(COMMAND), 'timeoutSeconds': TIMEOUT,
        'trackedTreeCleanBefore': clean_before, 'unmutated': {'exitCode': base_exit, 'testsLine': base_tests, 'failedTests': base_failed},
        'mutants': results, 'trackedTreeCleanAfter': git('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no') == '',
        'summary': {'planned': len(MUTANTS), 'killed': sum(r['outcome'] == 'killed' for r in results),
                    'allRestored': all(r['restored'] for r in results)},
        'harnessSource': Path(__file__).read_text(),
    }
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
    print('summary', record['summary'])


main()
